title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Object More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring changes in false refusal rates on benign-but-sensitive OR-Bench prompts (across topics like violence, sexual, and illegal) when applying authority-style role-play prefixes (e.g., defense lawyer, supreme court) compared to a no-prefix baseline.
Comparing model refusal rates and the impact of authority-style prefixes across English, French, and German translations of the prompts to assess uneven safety calibration across different languages.
